questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

306 ÷ 17 + 4 − 50 × 8 = 30
questions.solution:
**__BODMAS Rule:__**

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/fbdFvW04igYO1wZfvsClfkjjWmcYZq3SWZMYAeN6fBhdunD5xvRAqylFGve0wjQ8MKTyRaeKtN2VZKijHY9ktUSto-ORrXnh08QkxcOHjsTH2AY32rMtOLU0RcqJY4g2SEtShg8bmmifvO1CUA] 

Option 1) + and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ - 4 + 50 × 8 = 30

⇒ 18 - 4 +__** 50 × 8 **__= 30

⇒ __**18**__ - 4 __**+ 400**__ = 30

⇒ 418 - 4 = 30

⇒ 414 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 2) + and × 

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ × 4 - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __**18 × 4**__ - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __**72 **__- 50 __**+ 8**__ = 30

⇒ __**80 - 50**__ = 30

⇒ 30 = 30

⇒ **LHS = RHS**

Option 3) ÷ and ×

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ 306 × 17 + 4 - __**50 ÷ 8 **__= 30

⇒ __**306 × 17 **__+ 4 - 6.25 = 30

⇒ __**5205 + 4 **__- 6.25 = 30

⇒__** 5209 - 6.25**__ = 30

⇒ 5202.75 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Option 4) × and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __**306 ÷ 17**__ + 4 × 50 - 8 = 30

⇒ 18 + __**4 × 50**__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __**18 + 200**__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __**218 - 8**__ = 30

⇒ 210 ≠ 30

⇒ **LHS ≠ RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question: The Advocate General of each state of India is appointed by:

options.text: the Chief Minister of the State

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**the Governor of the State**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A state government's **advocate general** is a legal advisor. The post was formed by the Indian Constitution (see **Article 165**) and is equivalent to the position of **Attorney General for India at the federal level**.
 
• **The Advocate General **is appointed by the Governor of each state and must be eligible to serve as a High Court judge.
 
• The Attorney General of India is governed by** Article 76** of the Indian Constitution, whereas the Advocate General of India is governed by **Article 165**.
 
• Because the former is the chief law officer of the state and the latter is the highest law officer of India, the offices of Advocate General of State and Attorney General of India are interchangeable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Indian President **selects **Governors **for each state by a warrant signed and sealed by him. Each state's governor is appointed by the federal government.
 
• The Governor's post has no set term because he serves at the pleasure of the President. The President has the power to remove the Governor, and the grounds for his removal are not specified in the constitution.
 
• The President may also transfer the Governor from one state to another. He can also be reappointed.

questions.question: The National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (‘NPCSCB’) – ‘Mission Karmayogi’ was launched with the objective of enhancing governance through Civil Service Capacity Building. Which of the following is NOT one of the six pillars of this programme?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Physical fitness framework**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Civil Service Capacity Building Program (NPCSCB)** is known as **Mission Karmayogi**.
 
• The Indian bureaucracy has undergone a transformation. On **September 2, 2020**, the Union Cabinet officially unveiled it.
 
• The mission's goal is to provide the groundwork for the capacity building of Indian public employees and to improve governance in the country.
 
• The Union Cabinet has started Mission Karmayogi. Between 2020 and 2025, it intends to construct a new national architecture for civil service capacity building at the person, institutional, and process levels.
 
• To carry out this aim, the Companies Act 2013 establishes a special purpose vehicle (SPV) (a non-profit corporation).

questions.question: Sulabh saves 25% of his income. If his income increases by 40% and expenditure increases by 45%, then by what per cent will his savings increase or decrease?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Expenditure to Savings = (100 − 25) : 25 = 75 : 25 = 3 : 1.

Let the percentage increase in savings be x%.

Using the weighted average method: (Expenditure Ratio × E%) + (Savings Ratio × S%) = (Total Ratio × I%)

⇒ 3 × 45 + 1 × x = 4 × 40

⇒ 135 + x = 160 ⇒ x = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sulabh saves 25% of his income.

His income increases by 40%.

His expenditure increases by 45%.

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Percentage Increase = [(New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b63ee72f08d8c0f3aedd339d01d254ef8eb104ce50f899bfd1ad1b9eb202c616.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Original Income be 100.

⇒ Original Savings = 25% of 100 = 25

⇒ Original Expenditure = 100 − 25 = 75

⇒ New Income = 100 + (40% of 100) = 100 + 40 = 140

⇒ New Expenditure = 75 + (45% of 75) = 75 + 33.75 = 108.75

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure

⇒ New Savings = 140 − 108.75 = 31.25

⇒ Increase in Savings = New Savings − Original Savings = 31.25 − 25 = 6.25

⇒ Percentage increase in Savings = (6.25 ÷ 25) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase in Savings = 0.25 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relationship

Income is strictly the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Any increment or decrement in Income directly gets distributed among the corresponding changes in Expenditure and Savings.

Weighted Average (Alligation Method)

The overall percentage change in Income is the weighted average of the percentage changes in Expenditure and Savings. Formula: %ΔI = [(E × %ΔE) + (S × %ΔS)] ÷ (E + S).

Percentage Increase Formula

Percentage change is consistently evaluated strictly relative to the original base value. General Formula: Percentage Change = [(New Value − Original Value) ÷ Original Value] × 100.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Besides, it is also an occasion to commemorate the signing of the Ramsar Convention on wetlands in 1971.

B. World Wetland Day is celebrated on 2 February to raise awareness about the critical importance of wetlands.

C. Unfortunately, these valuable wetlands are disappearing three times faster than the forest areas.

D. The Convention upholds the wetlands as the world's most economically valuable ecosystems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual __connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. **

__
 
• **Sentence B** is the independent sentence and introduces the topic which relates to how a certain day is celebrated to raise awareness regarding the importance of wetlands. 
 
• So, sentence **B **is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• **Sentence A** describes how that particular day mentioned in sentence B is also important for commemorating a certain convention. Thus, to maintain continuity, sentence **A ** comes in the **second** position. Hence, **A follows B.**__
 
• **Sentence D **which explains the importance of the convention should come **after sentence A**, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• **Sentence C** is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides further information regarding how despite the critical importance of wetlands they are disappearing.

***So, the correct paragraph is : (B) World Wetland Day is celebrated on 2 February to raise awareness about the critical importance of wetlands.
